data.narrative:
Space Forge is a Series G-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $22.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 13 comparable companies: five public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($22.6M) as a proxy for baseline valuation and applying a 1.25x multiplier typical for Series G advancement yields an implied valuation of $11.3M. This represents the only reliable triangulation method available; peer-median anchoring lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (0 same-stage datapoints; falling back to all-sector peers would introduce unacceptable noise), and public-comp P/S multiples cannot be applied without target revenue disclosure, which private companies rarely provide. The public sector median trades at 27.4x revenue, but this remains inaccessible without Space Forge's revenue figure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $13M, centered on $11M. This range carries material uncertainty given single-method derivation and the inherent difficulty of benchmarking early-stage aerospace ventures against later-stage public comparables. Key risks include lack of revenue visibility and sparse peer data at this exact stage. Investors should view this range as preliminary pending disclosure of operational metrics or additional comparable transaction data in the frontier-aerospace subsector.
